tests.description: Read, stage-object and commit tokens reject the wrong JWS typ, algorithm or key, cannot predate or outlive the bound Grant, and cannot cross operation, audience, route, grant, Tenant, WorkOrder or InvocationAttempt boundaries.
Decoded staging bytes match declared length and SHA-256 before quarantine acceptance.
Media type, object count, per-object bytes, total bytes and encoded-body limits are enforced before commit.
Provider and Gateway operations can only create quarantined staging metadata; Platform alone finalizes ArtifactVersion.

Egress tokens reject the wrong JWS typ, algorithm or key, cannot predate or outlive RuntimeAuthorization, and bind the exact operation Contract/Profile/request digest, destination, Gateway route, execution context, Policy, Budget and Permissions.
Runtime cannot provide a raw origin or override the registered destination authority.
DNS answers, connected IPs and every redirect are revalidated against private, loopback, link-local and metadata restrictions.
Hop-by-hop, Host and credential headers are filtered and encoded/decoded request and response limits are enforced.
